description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Woodfall Primus
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Woodfall Primus enters, it and Stalwart Successor trigger.
Resolve the Woodfall Primus trigger, destroying a noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Stalwart Successor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Woodfall Primus
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
